# Life OS font

Unmodified Source Han Sans CN Normal, release 2.005R, Adobe.
Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/blob/2.005R/SubsetOTF/CN/SourceHanSansCN-Normal.otf
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE.txt.

One regional CJK family includes Simplified Chinese and Latin glyphs. It is packaged
offline, with no runtime font download. Normal (350) balances quiet typography and
small-text legibility. Rare characters outside its cmap may use platform fallback.
The raw font is approximately 8 MiB; APK compression/size delta has not been measured
because this patch was prepared without the Android build toolchain.

Function-page icons are original 24-unit vector drawings in LifeModuleIcons.kt;
they contain no copied screenshot assets or third-party icon library.
